description: Eiskunstläuferin (figure skater) watercolor mural, lilac-pink. 9:16 interiors for video; mural stays full-wall and unobstructed. Cards 1-3: first round (kept). Cards 4-5: girl's-room redo of scenes 2 and 3 (owner feedback 04.11: craft table blocked the view, design must be for a girl). Cards 6-8 (04.11, owner: zoom is not interesting, CapCut does it for free): three NEW designs with dynamic ideas for real animation: 6 a woman steps into the room, 7 sun shadows move across floor and furniture, 8 depth layers for a sideways camera slide. Cards 9-10 (05.11, owner: the final frame of the reel, audience up to 10, age group schulkind 6-10, no bed, little furniture, the skater's dress on a hook, the whole mural visible): 9 frontal (looked like a cage), 10 angled 35-40 degrees with Canon EOS R5 + 28mm + f/8 + deep depth of field. Cards 11-16 (06.11, a test of the new board logic with other formats and styles): two cards per age group (baby under 2, vorschul 2-5, schulkind 6-10), three in 4:3 and three in 2:3 (`aspectRatio` of a card overrides the spec ratio), five different app styles, rooms almost empty, no people. Round A = 11-13, round B = 14-16. The cards in work are listed in specs/active_board.json. Cards l45_rand_* (06.11, owner: new run on 3 models, 9:16, fully random style): style, colour, key object, lighting and camera angle are random (seeded by `variation`), the mural stays unobstructed, the camera gear comes from the pools of trends.json.

cards.subject: a playful retro nursery for a baby under 2 years, with scalloped edges, round shapes and soft sunbeams
cards.scene: A bright room with a light oak parquet floor. A round quilted cream play mat lies in the middle of the floor with a smooth beechwood rattle on it. On the LEFT side wall, away from the mural: a scalloped wooden wall shelf with small wooden animal figures (an elephant, a giraffe and a lion) and, beside it, two wavy scalloped picture frames with retro sunrise and flower prints. A playful cluster bubble chandelier with frosted glass globes hangs high in the top-right corner of the ceiling, well above the top edge of the mural. Warm sunbeams from a window on the left cast soft dappled shadows across the floor and the mat. Palette: soft lilac, blush, butter cream and light oak.
cards.framing: Shot from the right part of the room at eye level, turned about 30 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the left side wall with the shelf is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, from its near edge to the far corner, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the oak floor with the mat fills the lower part.

cards.subject: a cheerful room for a girl aged 2 to 5, with a flower-shaped craft table, round bouclé poufs and scalloped details
cards.scene: A bright room with a light oak herringbone parquet floor and a plush cream dot rug. In the right half of the room, a low flower-shaped wooden craft table (50 cm high) with a wooden cup of wax crayons and an open drawing book, and next to it a stack of three round bouclé poufs in blush, lilac and butter cream (under 60 cm). On the RIGHT side wall, away from the mural: a scalloped wooden shelf with a few picture books and a small potted trailing ivy, and two wavy scalloped picture frames with retro prints. Warm golden-hour light from a window on the right makes soft long shadows on the floor. Palette: pastel lilac, blush, butter cream and light oak.
cards.framing: Shot from the left part of the room at child eye level, turned about 30 degrees toward the mural wall, a wide landscape frame so the right side wall with the shelf is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, from its near edge to the far corner, with the ceiling line above it and the skirting board below it.

tags.cameraAngle: from the far left corner of the room, turned about 30 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the left side wall is in view and the whole mural wall recedes in perspective

cards.subject: a cosy reading corner for a school-age girl (6 to 10 years) who is a figure skater, with a globe, a cork pinboard and a big floor cushion
cards.scene: A bright room with a light oak floor and a round cream wool rug. On the rug an oversized textured blush linen floor cushion with an open illustrated atlas on it, a classic globe on a turned solid-wood stand (60 cm high) beside it, and her white figure skates with blade guards next to the cushion. On the LEFT side wall, away from the mural: a natural cork pinboard with watercolour sketches of ice-rink swirls and petals, and a small oak wall shelf with a brass task lamp. Soft afternoon window light from the left. Palette: pastel lilac, blush, ivory, light oak and a touch of brass.
cards.framing: Shot from the right part of the room at standing eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the left side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the oak floor with the rug fills the lower part.
